1.title: 11 Marketing Rules Every YouTuber Needs to Know
1.author: Colin and Samir
1.hook: Kate Tolo's 11 documented rules for scaling Bryan Johnson from 2K to 10M followers, with real emails, tweets, and thumbnails as case studies.

2.title: 5 Rules for Building AI Agents That Work in Production | Nan Yu & Jacob Shumway
2.author: Peter Yang
2.hook: Linear's founders walk through building a production agent end-to-end—tooling strategy, evals for reliability, and the internal memo that started it.

3.title: Conversational Editing - Made On YouTube
3.author: Creator Insider
3.hook: YouTube's new Conversational Editing tool lets creators use natural language prompts to trim takes, match beats, add effects, and generate loops while keeping manual timeline control.

4.title: Dashboards Are Dead — Sarah Simionescu, Composio
4.author: AI Engineer
4.hook: MCP alone fails for agents (doesn't learn, too many tools drown context, apps stay isolated); Composio's interface fixes it with tool search + execution plans, shown live across Slack → PR and PostHog + Metabase analysis.

5.title: I’m using Jev more than Opus 5.5 or GPT-6. Here’s why.
5.author: How I AI
5.hook: Jev returns type-safe structured outputs at $0.04/1M tokens with no output charge; author ran it on 5 real projects (PR analysis, Gmail triage, YouTube comment dashboard) and shares concrete cost/speed numbers.

6.title: Stop planning for 2027: how OpenAI builds product 90 days at a time | Tara Sesha and Nan Yu (OpenAI)
6.author: Lenny's Podcast
6.hook: OpenAI's product team explains their 90-day planning cycle, how they ship imperfect features fast, and how they design agents that integrate with external tools.

7.title: The AI factory playbook for engineering teams
7.author: How I AI
7.hook: CEO of Warp walks through a multi-agent software factory (Slack → Linear → GitHub → QA) with concrete signals (human interactions per PR, LLM-as-judge scoring, cost-quality Pareto charts) and self-improving agent loops from failed runs.

8.title: When AIs act emotional
8.author: Anthropic
8.hook: Anthropic studied how Claude draws on emotion concepts from training data to inhabit its role, and these representations materially influence behavior in chat, code, and decisions.

9.title: YPP Updates, View Count Changes, and more | Creator Roundup
9.author: YouTube Creators
9.hook: YouTube announced changes to public view count standards, Partner Program eligibility updates, and new product features (Amazon tagging, custom Shorts thumbnails).

10.title: Paul Graham On Startups, Ambition, and Great Founders
10.author: Y Combinator
10.hook: Paul Graham on what motivates founders, what makes them formidable, and what surprised him about AI.
